description: Memorial website for Tuval Yaakov Tzanani - Lecture booking landing page by Ravid Tzanani
author: Ravid Tzanani
_INVARIANT: Every dependency in this file is one the rebuild has a named use for. The customer build's 12 unused runtime deps and all 49 shadcn ui/* components are absent by construction (ledger D-2).
_IMPOSSIBLE: A component cannot import recharts / embla-carousel-react / react-day-picker / date-fns / cmdk / vaul / input-otp / react-resizable-panels / next-themes / react-hook-form / @hookform/resolvers / @tanstack/react-query / lovable-tagger: they are not in the module graph, so such an import is a build error, not a silent dead weight.
_HONEST_LIMIT: This file guarantees only that a package is INSTALLED, never that it is USED. It cannot stop a NEW dead dependency from being added later; it only proves none of the customer's known-dead set is here today. It also does not pin transitive versions - package-lock.json does. lucide-react is NOT installed: the brief's dependency set does not name it; if W4 sections need icons, that is one line plus one install, and it must be justified in the ledger.
